text_block_list.text:
While out running errands, I spotted Nice Nature and
the others accompanying a young horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
O youthful young maiden.
How about a pair of shoes like these?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yeah, I'll take these!
Thanks, big sis Nature!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh~! They're cute and look super easy to run in♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you're happy with them, that's great.
Big sis Nature is happy too~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nah, nope.
Met this kid through volunteer work.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: She asked us to help her pick out running shoes~.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! With these shoes,
I wanna win first place for real this time!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oho... you're really fired up, huh.
Ah, to be young~. Gotta love youth~~.
choice_data_list: You're young as well, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Besides, Nature, you've felt
that burning fire before too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no way. Actually, before I even got fired up,
reality hit me hard...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Did self-practice. Legs feel good.
...All that's left is to get results.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Jeez~. A dead heat with McQueen again~!?
Stop sticking right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What! That is my line!
I fully intended to leave you far behind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Haa... haa...*
Once again... couldn't pull up... beside them... not even once...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Haha.
No matter how hard I try, this is all I've got... huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And that's when I learned how out of my league I was.
...Well, probably sounds totally foreign to you young'uns.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all... I get it.
Because to me, Nature, you're—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: My "Teio and McQueen"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm really just an ordinary girl, so...
Most of the time, I can't even place on the race board.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Nature. You always place on the board,
you're consistent... It feels out of reach, but you're my goal!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But since you're zoning out right now,
does that mean this is my chance to catch up...!?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance! I'm gonna catch up to Nature-oneechan, just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hehehe!
Man, you really got me there~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To think someone's burning with fire just to beat me.
What an admirable young kiddo~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Seriously though,
I can't afford to slack off now, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Seriously though,
I can't afford to slack off now, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
I-I mean... technically speaking, I'm still a novice myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! Hot blood, burning fire!
Nature, I'm not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Horse Girl Child
text_block_list.text: Burning fire~! I won't lose, yeahhh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Gaaahhh! What is this atmosphere?!
No way! Stop! I can't handle this!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Teio and the others declare war in atmospheres like this all the time, don't they...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Guess I gotta start with mental training first, yup...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geh.
Trainer, you're looking ready to coach like crazy too?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! A formidable rival appears!
This development is really getting me pumped up~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy. I was really hoping those formidable rivals
would just space out and chill instead~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I should get new shoes, too.
Looks like I've gotta prepare to intercept them?
